annotations.title: Delete a Google Business Profile Post

description: Remove a Post from the brand’s Google Business Profile listing. This takes it off Google Search and Maps immediately and CANNOT be undone — confirm with the user first. Pass the full post name from list_google_business_posts. Needs Google Business Profile connected.

brand.description: WHICH PROFILE the post lives in, for THIS CALL ONLY: an id or exact name from list_brands, needed when it was published in a profile this connection is not pinned to. A name that matches no profile, or two, is REFUSED and nothing is done.

postId.description: the full post name from list_google_business_posts (accounts/…/locations/…/localPosts/…)
